title: Instagram Video Downloader
summary: Download & save instagram videos, photos and stories
description:
InstaBox is the fastest and easiest way to download and save videos, photos, and stories from instagram directly to your phone's gallery.

Just paste a link — InstaBox does the rest. No login, no sign-up, no hassle. Your downloads are saved straight to your gallery, so you can watch and share them anytime, even offline.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Copy the link of any video, photo, or story from your favorite social media app.
2. Open InstaBox — the link is detected automatically from your clipboard.
3. Tap Download and the media is saved to your gallery instantly.

FEATURES
- Download social media videos in high quality
- Save videos with their original sound
- Download photos and full multi-image posts (carousels)
- Save stories before they disappear
- Automatic clipboard link detection — one tap to start
- Saves directly to your gallery (DCIM / Pictures)
- Watch your saved videos offline, anytime
- No login or registration required
- Fast, lightweight, and simple to use
- Re-share downloaded content with your friends

WHY INSTABOX?
InstaBox keeps things simple: paste a link and save. No complicated steps, no accounts, and no clutter — just a clean, fast downloader that gets your favorite videos, photos, and stories onto your device in seconds.

Upgrade to Premium for an ad-free experience and unlimited downloads.

DISCLAIMER

Please respect copyright: only download content you have the right to use, and always credit the original creator. InstaBox does not host any content — it only helps you save media you already have permission to access.
